description: Turn the link of a public Chess.com live game or a Lichess game into a chessigma.com link that imports the game and opens a move-by-move review, computed by Stockfish in the user's browser. Nothing is fetched when this tool runs: the game is read from Chess.com or Lichess only when the user opens the link. Chess.com daily (correspondence) games are not supported; ask for the PGN instead.

url.description: A Chess.com live game link or a Lichess game link.

name: review_online_game
title: Review Online Game
